clips.title: The story
paras: A horror stalks a cave on Thorn Hill in the Barrens, where the Razormane call it Chol'aruk the Ravener. Bainham seeks its severed head to avenge comrades lost to similar beasts.

Northwest of Bainham's camp in the Barrens, Thorn Hill rises above the Savannah. Razormane tribes have long fought over the plateau. Now rumors speak of a monstrous abomination in one of its caves, called Chol'aruk or the Ravener by the Razormane. Some travelers dismiss tales that it can swallow an armored orc whole. Those who have seen the carnage know the danger is real.

Bainham knows Chol'aruk is no campfire tale. He has fought similar horrors and bears scars from those encounters, while mourning comrades who fell to such beasts. He fears the abomination threatens everyone crossing the Savannah. Bainham asks seasoned champions to climb Thorn Hill, enter its underground lair, slay Chol'aruk, and bring back its massive head.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.
Few believe such tales, but I do... Because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.
Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
